name: woodpecker-cli
description: woodpecker-cli — Woodpecker CI command line. Trigger pipelines, view logs, manage secrets and repos.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/woodpecker-ci/woodpecker/releases/latest/download/woodpecker-cli_linux_amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf woodpecker-cli_linux_amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv woodpecker-cli /usr/local/bin/ && rm woodpecker-cli_linux_amd64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.

commands.description: woodpecker-cli — Woodpecker CI command line. Trigger pipelines, view logs, manage secrets and repos.
